quarterly_data.signal: R&D roadmap: in mass production for advanced microlithography - rinse material (surface modifier), BARC, EBR and cleaner; next-node versions of these plus DUV photoresists (KrF, ArF), bottom layer and advanced BARC are in verification or development. Advanced packaging materials in mass production - temporary protection layer, plasma dicing glue and protection layer for SoIC; KrF BARC, cleaner, protection glue for CPO, leveling layer, high-AR photoresist, packaging glue and fine-pitch QFN photoresist are in verification or development. Company claim: its rinse materials' defect-reduction performance 'ranks No. 1 in the world'
